jobText:
Senior Software Engineer, Flight Software
Orbitline Aerospace · El Segundo, CA (onsite)

You'll build flight software in C++ for our next-generation launch vehicle and work closely with GNC and avionics teams.

Requirements
- 5+ years of C++ in embedded or real-time systems
- Experience with Linux and hardware-in-the-loop testing

This position requires access to technology subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

Compensation: $165,000 - $210,000 per year.
